recommendations.title: Fix the stale systemd unit warning permanently
recommendations.reason: Every gateway restart logs a WARNING about TimeoutStopSec=90s vs drain_timeout=180s. The fix is a one-liner: `hermes gateway service install --replace`, but it's been recurring for days without being addressed. Left alone it risks the gateway being SIGKILL'd by systemd mid-drain during a restart.
recommendations.action: Run `hermes gateway service install --replace` from a shell, then `systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl restart hermes-gateway`. Verify the warning disappears from logs.

non_negotiable.title: Fix the stale hermes-gateway systemd unit before the next restart
non_negotiable.reason: The gateway has been restarting multiple times per day (evidenced by the logs — Jun 25, Jun 26, Jun 27 all show shutdown/startup cycles). Every time it restarts with the current stale unit config, systemd may SIGKILL it mid-drain when TimeoutStopSec=90s fires against a 180s drain_timeout. This is a data-loss and stability risk that compounds with every restart.
non_negotiable.action: From a separate shell (not inside the gateway process): `hermes gateway service install --replace && sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl restart hermes-gateway`. Then check `journalctl -u hermes-gateway -n 20` to confirm no more stale-unit warnings.
